## Summary

Built **Signal Drift**, a complete Three.js corridor-flight game, in `src/game/`:

- **`course.ts`** — seeded (94721) `CatmullRomCurve3` spine defining a curving corridor with 3 ordered relay gates, an extraction ring, patrol hazards, charge orbs, and runway-light pylons.
- **`environment.ts`** — procedural sky dome, animated FBM shader cloud sea, starfield, instanced pylons/orbs, gate visuals.
- **`craft.ts`** — procedural low-poly ship (hull, canopy, wings, fins, engine flame/light), corrected so the nose faces the direction of travel.
- **`game.ts`** — core loop: corridor-relative flight physics (speed/steering/banking), charge drain/pickup, ordered relay restoration, storm boundary, hazard collisions with knockback/shake, win/lose conditions, chase camera with FOV kick and shake, and the `window.__AETHERPLAY__` state publisher.
- **`input.ts`** — keyboard (arrows/WASD/Shift/R) plus an on-screen joystick + boost button for touch.
- **`hud.ts`** / **`style.css`** — start overlay, HUD (charge bar, relay pips, objective, score), toasts, win/lose/pause overlays, responsive down to 390×844.
- **`audio.ts`** — WebAudio-synthesized SFX/engine hum, gated behind first user gesture.
- **`particles.ts`** — pooled additive point-sprite system for engine trail and pickup/impact/win bursts.

**Verification performed** (headless Chromium via CDP, since no Playwright/Puppeteer package was available — drove the local SwiftShader Chromium binary directly with a small W…
